rates.source: User-provided Standard prices, 2026-10-31. Base tier for per-request prompt input <=272000 tokens, including cached input.
User-provided Standard long-prompt rule, 2026-10-31. Entire request is repriced when prompt input >272000 tokens: input/cache 2x, output 1.5x. Cache writes retain the 1.25x input rate.

aggregate_request_bounds.source: User-confirmed pricing assumption, 2026-10-31: this Codex batch did not exceed the 272K prompt limit. Use base Standard rates for aggregate usage; not independently verified from per-request logs.

temporary_failure_cost_policy.source: User instruction, 2026-10-31: temporarily count the two explicitly listed provisional failed runs as USD 0. Original usage and pre-override cost estimates are retained separately; missing timings remain unknown.

notes: Sol/Codex uses the user-declared 272K request bound. The two explicitly listed provisional failed runs are temporarily counted as USD 0 by user instruction; original usage and pre-override costs remain in the evidence.
